content: Table 2 shows a comparison of the discussed settings on both SQuAD and TriviaQA. Without any fine-tuning (column 0) the performance is low, probably because the model never saw a real question, but we see significant gains with Cloze pretraining even with very little labeled data. The BiDAF+SA model, exceeds an F1 score of $50\%$ with only $1\%$ of the training data (454 questions for SQuAD, and 746 questions for TriviaQA), and approaches $90\%$ of the best performance with only $10\%$ labeled data. The gains over the SL setting, however, diminish as the size of the labeled set increases and are small when the full dataset is available.
